symbols.name: CyGPUInspectorRS_RequestCapture
symbols.description:
Queue a bounded deep capture in the process hosting the ReShade add-on. A connected standalone saves the resulting capture. A newer request replaces the pending request.

Include: `CyGPUInspectorCore/InProcessApi.h`. Module: CyGPUInspectorRS.addon64; resolve the named export in the host process.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Initialized capture options; size must describe the caller’s structure. frame_count is clamped to 1–8.

symbols.returns: 1 when queued for the next present; 0 if no device exists or the options are null/too small. Completion is asynchronous.

symbols.name: CyGPUInspectorRS_GetStatus
symbols.description:
Read the most recent device, connection, capture and frame state. Poll capture_stage rather than treating an accepted request as a completed capture.

Include: `CyGPUInspectorCore/InProcessApi.h`. Module: CyGPUInspectorRS.addon64; resolve the named export in the host process.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Writable structure with size set to sizeof(CygiStatus); at least the size field must fit.

symbols.returns: 1 after copying the supported prefix; 0 for a null or undersized status. The returned size is the number of bytes written.

symbols.name: CyGPUInspectorRS_GetApiVersion
symbols.description:
Check the exported API version before calling version-specific entry points such as SetViewportScope.

Include: `CyGPUInspectorCore/InProcessApi.h`. Module: CyGPUInspectorRS.addon64; resolve the named export in the host process.
symbols.returns: The add-on’s in-process API version; the current header defines 2.

symbols.name: CyGPUInspectorRS_SetViewportScope
symbols.description:
Limit capture to the host viewport using marker textures and its final image. Version 2 is required. Keep the resources alive while the scope is active.

Include: `CyGPUInspectorCore/InProcessApi.h`. Module: CyGPUInspectorRS.addon64; resolve the named export in the host process.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Full version-2 structure. begin_marker/end_marker are native marker texture handles; final_image is the viewport result. All three zero clear the scope.

symbols.returns: 1 when stored; 0 if the pointer is null or size is smaller than sizeof(CygiViewportScope).

symbols.name: cygi::ModPackage::Save
symbols.description:
Save explicit replacement/disable entries as a portable .cygimod directory. Preserve source provenance when available.

Include: `CyGPUInspectorCore/ModPackage.hpp`. Module: CyGPUInspectorCore.

parameters.name: directory
parameters.description: Destination package directory, created if needed.

symbols.returns: True on success; false on failure. Owned manifest/shader files are overwritten; unrelated files are preserved.

symbols.name: cygi::ModPackage::Load
symbols.signature: static bool cygi::ModPackage::Load(const std::string &directory, ModPackage &out, std::string &error, bool load_byte_code = true);
symbols.description:
Read a package written by Save. Matching is based on semantic hashes, not session-local shader IDs.

Include: `CyGPUInspectorCore/ModPackage.hpp`. Module: CyGPUInspectorCore.

parameters.name: out
parameters.description: Receives the parsed package. Use only after success.

parameters.name: load_byte_code
parameters.description: True loads shader blobs; false reads only manifest metadata for listings.

symbols.returns: True if the package was loaded; false if reading or validation failed.

symbols.name: cygi::ModPackage::LooksLikePackage

Use for folder listings before loading the selected package.

Include: `CyGPUInspectorCore/ModPackage.hpp`. Module: CyGPUInspectorCore.
symbols.returns: True when the directory looks like a package; this lightweight check does not replace Load validation.
